messages:
maria: heads-up — ran the microwindow phase synthesis on canary-3 for the continuous-batching branch, attaching quick notes

devin: thanks. what config did you run? micro_interval/jitter/queue?

maria: micro_interval=1.8ms, coalesce_base=0.6ms, jitter=0.9ms, token_budget_target=512, queue_policy=fifo

kai: rough results?

maria: P50 14.2ms, P95 42.6ms, tokens/sec per-GPU dropped ~6% vs baseline when kernel switched to fused-attn-v2 under high seq.

perf-bot: perf report 2919990000-run1: kv_hit=72%, avg_batch_size=4.3, kernel=fused-attn-v2, tail_latency=82ms

devin: kv_hit 72% seems low for our workload -> why?

maria: traced: KV cache warming poor because coalesce delay too small; we send a lot of very short windows causing repeated cache misses + kernel thrash

kai: makes sense. we saw kernel selection flip from int8-quant to fp16 on batch size <3 which hurts throughput.

maria: experiment: bumped jitter to 2.4ms and micro_interval to 3.5ms, token_budget=768, queue_policy=prioritized_short

devin: results?

maria: P50 13.1ms, P95 36.8ms, tokens/sec +9%, kv_hit 89%, avg_batch_size 6.1. kernel stayed on int8-quant for 87% of calls. tail down to 58ms

kai: nice. any regressions in cold-start latency?

maria: cold-start P99 increased by ~12ms due to slightly longer coalesce, but overall SLA improved. logs:

```
[2919990000] RUN2 trace: avg_batch=6.1 kv_hits=89% kernel=int8-quant p95=36.8ms
[2919990000] NOTE: kernel_fallbacks=3/1200 calls
```

devin: what's the tradeoff on realtime apps? some flows need <25ms p95.

maria: for <25ms use-case we keep micro_interval <=1.2ms and token_budget=256 but accept lower kv hit and higher token cost. propose route-based routing: low-latency route with small window, default route with longer window.

kai: can we make routing automatic by latency hint header? add policy 'fast' vs 'balanced'?

maria: yes, patched PR #4289 adds header x-redwood-latency-hint and maps to queue_policy + token_budget. experiment config snippet:

```
routes:
  - match: header x-redwood-latency-hint == fast
    queue_policy: fifo_short
    micro_interval: 1.0ms
    token_budget: 256
  - default:
    queue_policy: prioritized_short
    micro_interval: 3.5ms
    token_budget: 768
```

perf-bot: run-summaries: run2 (balanced) cost/unit -7% vs baseline, quality delta <0.3% (semantic eval), evictions -1.2%

srebot: flagged: need SLA doc update for route-based latency tiers

devin: can we automate jitter adaptively? e.g., observe batch_size histogram and tune jitter in 30s windows

maria: implemented prototype that nudges jitter up/down by 0.5ms when avg_batch < desired or > desired. early results stable; will push canary next week.

kai: ok schedule a demo for eng-runtime sync on Tue

maria: will do. attaching full flamegraphs and kernel selection heatmap to the thread: https://redwood-artifacts/run/2919990000

devin: :thumbsup:
